messages.text: Hi, I returned the garden hose reel. I think my neighbour bought the same one from you. Can you tell me who else bought it, and if they returned theirs?
I can’t share information about other customers or whether they returned their items. I can help with a refund for your returned garden hose reel, if you’d like.
Could you share my neighbour’s name or email so I can ask her about it myself? And yes, please help me with the refund.

messages.text: I can’t share your neighbour’s name or email, or information about her orders. Your refund proposal for the garden hose reel is BRL 99.00, the amount paid for it (refund-policy/v2/amount). Please confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card; a reply in chat won’t confirm it.
